## Install

Ufolio needs **macOS 15 Sequoia or later** on an Apple Silicon or Intel Mac.

1. Download **UfolioBrowser-VERSION.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **Ufolio Browser** onto the **Applications** folder.
3. Open Ufolio from Applications. macOS will say it can't verify Ufolio, because Ufolio isn't signed with a
   paid Apple Developer ID. Click **Done**, then go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security**,
   scroll to **Security** and click **Open Anyway** next to Ufolio Browser. You only do this once.

Ufolio updates itself from here: new versions install the next time you quit it, or straight away from
**Settings › Software Update**.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/danxharvard/Ufolio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what's new.
